reviews.title: Worst update
reviews.text:
PhotoRoom made a terrible change to the Batch Editor.

One of the best features was being able to resume a batch, add new photos, and have the same template/background automatically applied. That made it extremely fast for sellers like me who process a large number of product photos.

Now newly uploaded photos keep their original background, and I have to manually reapply the template every time. This adds unnecessary steps and makes the app slower and much less useful for high-volume eBay sellers.

I have used PhotoRoom because it saved me time. This update does the opposite.

Please bring back the option to automatically apply the previous or saved template when adding photos to a batch, or at least give users a setting to choose the default behavior.

Until this is fixed, I’m seriously considering switching to another app.

reviews.title: Misleading Free Trial and Unfair Billing
reviews.text:
The app advertises a one-week free trial, but I canceled on the very same day I signed up, and the app confirmed that my subscription was canceled. Despite this, I was still charged.

When I contacted support, they told me to contact Apple. When I contacted Apple, I was told to contact the developer. I have been sent back and forth between both parties, with neither taking responsibility or resolving the issue.

Advertising a free trial, confirming a cancellation, and then charging the customer anyway is unacceptable. What makes the experience even worse is the lack of accountability and the frustrating process of trying to get a straightforward billing issue resolved. Customers should not have to fight to avoid being charged after canceling within the advertised free-trial period.

This experience has left me feeling misled by the advertising and disappointed by the customer support. I would caution others to be careful before signing up for the free trial.

reviews.title: Extremely disappointed and frustrated
reviews.text:
I just discovered that I have been charged $12.99 EVERY SINGLE MONTH since December 2025, and it is now October 1, 2026. That’s roughly $130 that I have unknowingly spent on this app.

The worst part is that I had absolutely NO CLUE I was paying for this subscription. I have not knowingly used this app or intentionally signed up for a subscription. I only discovered the charges by going through my card transactions.

Once I finally realized what was happening, I tried to cancel the subscription, and canceling it was ridiculously difficult and confusing. It should NOT be this hard for someone to figure out how to stop recurring charges. If you’re going to make it easy to subscribe, it should be just as easy to cancel.

I’m extremely frustrated that I lost approximately $130 without even realizing I was being charged. That’s a significant amount of money, especially when I received no clear indication that I was continuously paying for a subscription I wasn’t using.

I really hope Photoroom takes responsibility for this and considers refunding these charges. I understand that subscriptions can be easy to overlook, but the fact that I couldn’t even easily figure out where the subscription was coming from or how to cancel it made this experience even worse.

Check your bank and credit card statements if you have ever downloaded this app, because apparently you can be charged month after month without realizing it. I’m extremely disappointed and will not be using Photoroom again.

reviews.title: Unreasonable charges
reviews.text:
⚠️ PLEASE BE EXTREMELY CAREFUL BEFORE PURCHASING ANYTHING THROUGH THIS APP.

I signed up for a yearly subscription ONE TIME, and somehow I was charged six consecutive times, once every week, for a plan I never signed up for or authorized.

What makes this even more disturbing is that I wasn’t even opening or using the app during this time, yet the charges continued to come out of my account.

I never knowingly agreed to these additional subscriptions or recurring charges, and I certainly did not authorize someone to keep charging my account week after week. Now I’m left dealing with approximately $200 in negative balance in my bank account because of charges I never expected or approved.

The tools themselves may work, but the way these subscriptions and charges were handled has been an absolute nightmare. A subscription should NEVER be changed or added without the customer’s knowledge and consent.

If you’re considering purchasing anything through this app, please check your bank account and subscription settings very carefully. I would strongly recommend making sure you understand exactly what you’re being charged for and monitoring your account afterward.

What was supposed to be a single yearly purchase turned into multiple unexpected weekly charges and a negative bank balance. That’s completely unacceptable from my experience.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: Do not download this app unless you want your money stolen. The signup screen is a massive trap designed to trick users into accidental annual subscriptions. The page screams "Start your 7-Day Free Trial" in huge bold letters right above a prominent blue "Continue" button.Because a family member had briefly tested this app on my Apple ID in the past, Photoroom’s layout completely hid the fact that I was ineligible for the trial. The second I hit continue, Apple’s billing system bypassed the trial entirely and instantly extracted a massive annual fee of £69.99 from my account without a single dynamic warning on the payment screen.I canceled the subscription within minutes of realizing what happened, but both companies have been completely useless and predatory. I spent two exhausting days on the phone with Apple getting the run-around from automated scripts, only to be denied. I then emailed Photoroom directly, and their support agent "Kate" just pointed fingers back at Apple, refusing to take corporate responsibility for their own misleading app interface.In the 21st century, it is shocking that a massive developer is allowed to get away with using these deceptive "dark pattern" layouts to trap everyday consumers. It is dishonest, unfair, and feels like a complete scam. I have had to file a formal dispute with my bank to get my money back by force. Absolutely disgraceful company.

reviews.title: This used to be an amazing app until they updated it.
reviews.text: This used to be an amazing app, I used it for product images until they updated it to the point it became unusable. If you’re ok with making individual images, this app is great, but if you want  multiple images with consistent backgrounds for a professional look, you won’t be able to do that here. This app used to be amazing. I used it for all my product images. There were preset background images you could use to have consistency between products. But a few months ago they removed those preset images in an update. I went back and forth with their support for weeks, and they finally told me I should be using prompts for better creativity. But even if I use the same prompt, I get wildly different background images. It’s impossible to make consistent backgrounds so all of your products have the same look. Now when you generate images, you’re using up your account credits. In one day I used up almost half of my credits just trying to get a consistent background on TWO product images. Having multiple products with wildly different backgrounds looks unprofessional. I’m seriously disappointed  because this used to be the perfect app for creating consistent and professional images.

reviews.title: Going downhill
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Photoroom for editing my product photos for Etsy, and when I first started, I genuinely loved it. It made background removal and product presentation so much easier, and it really helped elevate my listings.

However, over time, the experience has gone downhill, especially considering that I’m paying for the service. The biggest issue is how limited everything has become. Features that used to feel flexible and useful now come with strict “allowances.” For example, I’ve only used the batch feature a few times, yet I’m already being told I’ve used 80% of my limit. It feels like everything is being restricted more and more, which doesn’t make sense for a paid subscription.

Another major disappointment is the background generation. Before, I used to get multiple background options to choose from, which made it easy to find something that matched my product. Now, it only gives one option at a time, and I have to keep retrying over and over just to get a different result. Even then, the quality has dropped significantly. The AI often doesn’t match the product properly, creates distortions, and the final images just don’t look realistic or professional anymore.

It’s frustrating because this used to be a tool I relied on and really enjoyed using for my business. But at this point, it no longer feels worth the cost. The quality has decreased while the limitations have increased.

Unfortunately, this will probably be the last time I pay for it. I used to recommend it

reviews.text: There is no free element to this app, a subscription is required to use it. After a very quick demo, you are directed to choose a pro or max subscription. Prices for either subscription are not displayed. When I downloaded the app, as it said in app purchases I assumed there would be a free - albeit restricted - option. But no. And based on many other reviews saying cancelling after the free trial isn’t possible, I certainly won’t be signing up. So don’t bother downloading unless you intend on signing up to a subscription.

reviews.title: Avoid
reviews.text: Check the cancellation policy. Like other reviewers they’ve made it really hard to cancel.

reviews.title: Sucks

reviews.title: Tried to scam me, don’t trust the free trial
reviews.text:
I’ve been looking for an AI editor and wanted to try this so was happy to see they offer a free trial. However when I tried to sign up for the 7 day free trial they tried to charge my card straight away for the £35 subscription. Immediately deleted. 
I’ve been caught out by fake free trials before and it’s always nearly impossible to get a refund

reviews.title: Unable to cancel
reviews.text: They made it soooo difficult to cancel its like jumping through unlimited hoops , my mental health was affected once i saw the £9.99 leave my account , i will never ever subscribe to anything again. The app itself however was not bad at all. Just need more instructions on cancellation.

reviews.title: No help
reviews.text: I was really hoping this would be a great app. I signed up for the MAX subscription as it noted one of the benefits was better customer service… haha what a joke that was. I reached out when the 360 video feature wasn’t creating 360 videos 🫠 this was the main reason we needed the app. I reached out to be told the feature had some problems and they were being looked in to. No problem these things happen. I did ask if the credits we had used trying to use the feature would be credited back so we could use them when the app was working properly. No reply, reached out again a few days later when the same feature was still having issues, no reply. I tried the feature again a few days after, same issue. It’s now a week on tried the feature again, same issue not creating 360 videos. So wasted half of our monthly credits on the feature that doesn’t work. And still no response. So paying the premium service was pointless as there is no form of customer service

reviews.title: Use to be good!!!
reviews.text: This app use to be great, but a while ago they changed something so now it’s quite pointless!! I use to use it to change backgrounds before it I asked for a certain background it was great at creating it but now it just gives you a studio background. Bring back the old features!!!!

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: Started free trial and immediately cancelled after 7days free trial I was happy to be paying the £69.99 yearly but that would have come with limited features. I tried to create a video and it sent me to upgrade my subscription to nearly £250 year subscription. I didn’t even get a preview of what the video would have looked like. I’m my experience with these type of apps they claim to be great but you pay and the product is shocking. Won’t be risking it. If you want to remove background from photos etc use canva.

reviews.title: Extremely poor App and service
reviews.text: I signed up to a free trial and wasn’t satisfied immediately. The cancellation process does not work and  continues to redirect you in circles to the home page on “how to cancel.” Tech support did not provide assistance with this before the free trial concluded which then proceeded to bill my account for the year. Very disappointing and still no feedback from help desk since. I’ve since had to contact Apples support line to get some communication from this app. Would not recommend!

reviews.title: Very buggy
reviews.text:
I’ve had a subscription to this app for two years and it keeps on disappointing me. You keep on changing the versions and it gets more buggy as it goes on at this moment. I can’t insert something into a picture. But it’s not the only thing that has been really buggy about this, but that’s my current concern. It’s not being able to insert pictures into other pictures. When it works, it works great, but it has to work. I have two other small business owners who use this just like me who are having the same problem. It’s hard to get from one screen to another because it freezes. I have to restart the app. I tried deleting the app and reinstalling the app. I do want to give you props for having so many wonderful features that are easy to use when they work. But they have to work. You used to have this version that you were able to take pictures and use them as examples when creating something with AI you can’t now. It gets very buggy when you do switch to that version cause I know you’re phasing it out.
I just feel like the app is becoming harder to use and you’re adding more and more bugs that weren’t in those programs in the first place

reviews.title: Longterm Customer, Cancelling Subscription after Poor Customer Service Experience
reviews.text: I’ve been a subscribed user for more than two years and I use this for my business. I recently started a new business and needed to take a lot of photos for new inventory. Photoroom capped the number of images for bulk upload. I upgraded my membership and was still capped and would hit my max 10 days into my monthly cycle. I reached out to see if they could extend my max upload for a month and because I upgraded my membership I didn’t qualify for a temporary legacy extension. I was upset, I’ve been a supporter and paying customer for over two years. I have deleted the app and cancelled my recently placed subscription. I will never use the app again, not recommend it to anyone. The customer service was slow, and very poor. It’s unfortunate.

reviews.title: Quiero dar de baja
reviews.text: Me siguen cobrando cuando ya no la tengo

reviews.title: Greed strikes again
reviews.text: We have always been a photoroom family. W e have been using the app for years and years. First I used it then I told my mom my brother and extended family. They all would use it for their business. We were so happy to hear that plans could be shared within a household and we were able to take advantage of that feature. We only used the app for bulk editing a white background. It was easy to use and fast and efficient. On the latest update, they have taken away multiple users, and they have put a cap on how many photos you can do just a simple white background. This company would rather lose customers than lose penny’s on ai tokens to let people generate more photos. I’m taking my business elsewhere and would rather pay a premium fee somewhere that won’t limit me.

reviews.title: Price gouging
reviews.text: Paid for a yearly subscription a few months ago for the pro tier and the product was working great. Now half way through the subscription they have put limits on everything and introduced a new tier at more than triple the cost, with even that tier having limits. Good for casual users, has become a terrible deal for business users. Whatever subscription you buy be ready for them to change it at will.

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text:
DO NOT USE THIS APP, ITS A SCAM!

I have been battling costumer support, the app is horrible to navigate, to get some help you have to go through loops even to cancel subscriptions they make it hard, you can only cancel subscriptions through the system you used when signing up for it, and when there is an error you have to email the team and it takes forever to get any answers!! Yes, I was trying to cancel my subscription in the correct way (as it depends how you subscribed, mine was in the app and not via App Store) I had to log into the website on a laptop to be able to navigate to a working unsubscribe button. reviews.title: Very limited access for the money you pay
reviews.text:
I hate negative reviews. I would rather deal with the company and get the problem fixed. However this isn’t happening. It takes days for them to respond (that is if they respond) and the response isn’t the correct information. I paid $249 max yearly plan, had the app for a week, downloaded maybe 5 videos. I am maxed out and can’t create anymore for a month. I was told it was because I was on the pro plan when I’m not I am on the Max plan. I was also told the videos are very limited. 5 videos download is a ridiculous limit for the money this app cost. 
This app creates the best videos. Better than you can imagine. Just know you won’t get that many for what you pay. Also, it doesn’t tell you what the limit is. 
Hopefully they will improve so I can comeback on here and give them 5 stars and a great review.

reviews.title: Purchased an annual plan months ago. New update = theft.
reviews.text: Imagine signing up for a yearly subscription, then halfway through it your ability to use the subscription is capped. I bought a subscription to the app before this limit was placed, so in other words, dear developers, you’re not upholding the contract / promise to render the service I purchased. I did not purchase what the app is currently, becaus who in their right mind would? If you considered this, i should not be subject to these export limits until my annual subscription expires (i.e., grandfathered into the service I ACTUALLY purchased months ago), because if I were aware of this, I would have NEVER signed up for an annual plan. This failure to provide the service I purchased is legally dubious, and I will be taking further steps in light of these recent “improvements”. They are not improvements, they are downright theft. I would give 0 stars if I could, for the dishonest business practices and lack of transparency. Do not download.

reviews.title: Bait And Switch
reviews.text: I have been using this app for over two years. It is always buggy. There are always long stretches where things do not work well or at all. Recently, after renewing a yearly subscription for unlimited batch exports on background removals, they rolled out new plan limits that made it to where on the pro plan you can only export 500 images with backgrounds removed in the batch tool per month. Solution, upgrade to $250 Max plan to only be able to do 1,500 images per month. Pulled a complete bait and switch and refused to refund. Had to go to Apple to get a refund. They do not care about their customers only their bottom line. I never even used any AI features. So if you are just looking for background removals there are much cheaper options that will function better out there.

Era una app excelente! Me encantaba pero con esto último no sé si serán actualizaciones o problemas en el sistema no te deja trabajar y perdes tiempo

reviews.title: From the a 5star app down to 1 star!
reviews.text:
You ruined it with now introducing the AI usage limit of 30 image ‘credits’ per month. I’ve been a PRO user since the beginning and there was no limits for that, and you have now lost me with this absolute nonsense. Will find a better app. Such a shame you slowly but surely ruined a 5star app with every ‘upgrade’. I pay £50 a year but definitely won’t pay £250+ for the next tiers, that’s insane. 
Good luck because you definitely will need it by the looks of it.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Photoroom for a while, and unfortunately, it’s been a frustrating experience lately. The app has become very expensive, with a high yearly subscription fee that doesn’t seem justified given the on going issues. Every time there’s a new update, new bugs seem to appear, and the recently added photo limits make the app even less useful. 
On top of that there are unexpected export fees, which add to the overall cost. The biggest downside, though, is customer service - there’s no way to speak with anyone directly. You have to send an email and wait up to three days (sometimes longer) just to get a response. Which can be incredibly inconvenient if you’re trying to resolve a problem quickly. 
Overall, Photoroom feels unreliable and overly priced.  I really hope they address the bugs, improve communication, and offer more transparent pricing.

reviews.title: Great app. Terrible support.
reviews.text: I’ve been using photoroom for my business for over 2 years and the experience has been pretty positive with functionality and usage of the app itself. HOWEVER, support is the downside. Firstly, they update the app nearly every day which is great but it’s inconsistent. Some changes make sense, while others completely change the way you use the app. They’ve implement new features that track how many exports you can do a month, which was never a feature before so now you are limited on exports unless you pay more, which hurts users like myself who’ve been using the app for years. Secondly, support is almost non existent. At first you only get to message with an ai bot who provides inconsistent and false information, then it gets escalated to a real person but a response from them could take anywhere from 1 hour to literal days. I have been waiting on a response for 3 days in regard to their new export limit feature not resetting at the beginning of the month as it should. So now on the first week of November I have only half my exports remaining. I keep coming back to Photoroom because of its accessibility but the glitches that come with every update, lack of transparency and terrible support are driving me away.
